modules.title: Module 1: C Architecture, Compilation & Memory Footprint
modules.description: GCC compilation stages (Preprocessor, Compiler, Assembler, Linker), sizeof operator, primitive types, and format specifiers.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: The 4 Stages of C Compilation (Preprocess, Compile, Assemble, Link)

challenge.task: Print 'Hello C' to stdout using printf in C.

lessons.content:
⚡
30-Second Mental Model

C code 4 stages se guzarta hai: Preprocessor (.i) -> Compiler (.s assembly) -> Assembler (.o object binary) -> Linker (final executable).

Hardware Level
Native Binary

Direct CPU instruction execution without virtual machine overhead.

Compilation Pipeline

GCC pipeline transforms human code directly into machine machine OPCODES.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.2: Primitive Types & The sizeof() Memory Operator

challenge.task: Print the sizeof(int) in bytes using printf.

lessons.content:
⚡
30-Second Mental Model

sizeof() compile-time operator hota hai jo types aur variables ka exact byte size hardware architecture ke mutabiq return karta hai.

Memory Sizing
sizeof Operator

Evaluated at compile-time by the compiler.

Memory Footprint

Direct hardware memory byte alignment.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.3: Advanced printf Format Specifiers & Buffer Flushing

lessons.content:
⚡

printf format specifiers (%d, %x, %f, %p) binary memory ko human-readable strings mein format karte hain.

I/O Format
Format Specifiers

Low-level memory representation formatting.

I/O Buffering

stdout is line-buffered; '\n' flushes the buffer to the terminal.
